contentText:
It's Céline Dion fever in Paris. She returns to the stage this Saturday, opening a sold-out Paris residency.

It will be the first of 26 concerts over the next eight months. She is making a comeback after a battle with a neurological disorder that has sidelined her career.

On the eve of her first performance, there was a giant free karaoke singalong here in the French capital to get things going.
